exposure: presence of graduate medical education programs
cohort: 861 stillbirths without known congenital anomalies or aneuploidy born in an unspecified state from July 1, 2015 to June 30, 2019
finding: Annual hospital delivery volumes and residency teaching programs in obstetrics influence the mode of delivery in the management of stillbirth.
mod_finding: Advancing gestational age, Black race, and parity are associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery after stillbirth.
